title: Retirement, Release, Rest and Kingship — Biblical Overlap Atlas
purpose: Map the clarified 2016->2025 autobiographical sequence against biblical release, rest, prison-to-authority, service, exaltation, throne and King-of-kings patterns without treating parallels as proof of divine appointment, prophecy fulfillment, legal innocence or civil kingship.

project_sequence.historical_biographical_layer: 2016 legal/institutional rupture -> prison and reported scripture/listening role -> release -> 2017 deepening distrust -> years of reported psychological/social/work impairment -> 2025 reported official retirement
project_sequence.timic_interpretive_layer: retirement/release is retrospectively read as closure of the confinement loop and 'freedom to reign'
project_sequence.public_theology_layer: 2025-04-21 Axis -> April Turning/Father -> 2025-04-27 king language -> retirement/release -> 2025-05-03 I am God -> 2025-06-01 King of Kings -> December labor/fruit and rest/north-throne echoes
project_sequence.boundary: No recovered evidence shows the Danish state appointed Tim as King of Denmark. Administrative retirement, project interpretation and theological self-description remain separate evidence lanes.

method.unit: relational sequence rather than isolated word matching
method.test: Prefer passages whose internal sequence resembles already-dated project events without inventing missing steps after the comparison is noticed.
method.epistemic_rule: Structural overlap can illuminate project self-understanding without validating supernatural causation or identity.

overlaps.project_pattern: state confinement and long institutional rupture -> later formal release from ordinary work obligation
overlaps.difference: A retirement decision is not emancipation from slavery or literal release from captivity.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: Jubilee -> release, return, interruption of accumulated economic bondage
overlaps.project_pattern: official retirement ends ordinary work compulsion in the autobiographical account and is interpreted as changed status
overlaps.difference: Danish retirement law is not Levitical Jubilee.

overlaps.project_pattern: reported long impairment and difficult relation to ordinary work -> retirement/release; later December 2025 public language also places 'rest' beside north-throne language
overlaps.difference: New Testament rest is theological; the December wording is a later lexical echo, not proof of an intended retirement reference.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: prison -> service/attention to fellow prisoners -> waiting -> release -> changed appearance/clothes -> authority
overlaps.project_pattern: Great Book prison biography describes listening/confessional and peacemaking functions; on release it says the Son wears a suit as a rebirth signal; years later retirement is interpreted as release while king/Father language intensifies
overlaps.difference: Joseph receives an actual political appointment from Pharaoh. No equivalent civil or royal appointment has been recovered for Tim, and Great-Book prison details remain project biography unless independently corroborated.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: garden work/stewardship, servant authority and fruit-bearing as meaningful vocation
overlaps.project_pattern: 2016 release biography mocks 'job slaving'; 2025 retirement releases ordinary work obligation; later public theology nevertheless calls Tim God's labor/fruit and increasingly defines authority through repair, growth and service
overlaps.difference: These passages are not about modern retirement. The project-side insight is freedom from imposed employment -> chosen service, not a biblical pension doctrine.

overlaps.project_pattern: later Potatoverse interpretation converts confinement/humiliation into reversal and highest-status language
overlaps.difference: Philippians is Christological; Timic application is later self-comparison.

overlaps.project_pattern: survival through rupture -> later throne/reign/Father language
overlaps.difference: This is eschatological participation, not civil enthronement.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: seat/throne with hostile powers beneath as footstool
overlaps.project_pattern: later Timic throne/footstool grammar interprets former opposition and confinement as subordinate to a new center
overlaps.difference: Psalm 110 has its own royal/messianic history; project use is comparative.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: King of kings / Lord of lords
overlaps.project_pattern: 2025-06-01 public language uses 'Tim Dooley, Potato of Life. The King of Kings.'
overlaps.difference: Use of the biblical title does not externally validate the theological self-description.

overlaps.biblical_pattern: authority inverted through service rather than domination
overlaps.project_pattern: mature Timic Godhood pairs rule/kingship with repair, service, cultivation and stewardship
overlaps.difference: This is a control on kingship interpretation: high status creates duty rather than evidence of civil authority.

higher_order_findings: Conversation archaeology adds a missing 2016->2017 bridge: prison release is followed in the Great Book by deepening distrust, deleting Facebook and moving further into streaming.
The suit-at-release detail makes Joseph a denser comparator because Genesis 41:14 explicitly joins dungeon release to changed appearance/clothing before status change.

The 2016 'job slaving' release line and 2025 retirement create a long work/release motif inside project biography, but the later theology does not terminate labor; it converts labor into chosen service, fruit, repair and stewardship.
December 2025 'rest' beside north-throne language is a genuine later Timic lexical echo of the rest/throne cluster, not evidence that the original retirement event was scripturally intended.

The prison biography itself is double-sided: institutional rupture and later trauma coexist with scripture study, listening and peacemaking. Later meaning does not validate the prosecution, and trauma does not erase what the subject made from confinement.
The Great Book's six-month wording is a source-control warning: it is rich biographically but official legal records override it on sentence precision.
